  ?singer a :singer .
  BIND(COUNT(?singer) AS ?numSingers)
}

WHERE {

  ?singer :singer\#country ?country .
  FILTER (?singer :singer\#age > 40)
  UNION
  FILTER (?singer :singer\#age < 30)
}
GROUP BY ?country

  ?stadium :stadium\#capacity ?capacity .
  ?concert :concert\#ref-stadium_id ?stadium .
  FILTER (?capacity = (
    SELECT (MAX(?maxCapacity) AS ?maxCapacity)
    WHERE {
      ?stadium :stadium\#capacity ?maxCapacity .
    }
  ))
}
